Vartiovenne 55

LocationHietalahdenranta 19, Helsinki, Finland
Visited31 August 2025
WebsitePatrol Boat 55

Museum Report

Vartiovenne 55 is not a typical museum ship. She served in the Finnish Navy as the Minesweeper / Anti-Submarine Patrol Boat Röyttä from 1959 through to 1999. After six years in reserve she was sold in 2006.

Since 2012 she has been used as a commercial charter vessel under the name Vartiovenne 55 (literally patrol boat 55 – named after her pennant number when in Finnish Navy service). While her exterior retains a distinctive military appearance, her interior has been extensively modified with a sauna, spa and meeting room for parties and corporate events.

During summer she is berthed in Hietalahdenranta 19, in the Hietalahti/West Harbour area, which is where I stumbled across her. The wharf is open to the public so you can inspect her at leisure. Apparently in winter she relocates to Halkolaituri, on Pohjoisranta beside the northern harbour.
